title: Santa Rosa Ballooning
specs: Flights average 45 minutes to 1 hour with altitude from treetop level to about 3,000 feet
Pilots hold FAA-certified commercial Lighter-Than-Air pilot licenses and undergo routine physicals
Balloon baskets have 48-inch high padded sidewalls for security and comfort
Santa Rosa averages 256 sunny days a year with mild seasonal temperatures
Children must be at least 8 years old and 57 inches tall
Children must understand directions, stand for the duration of the flight, and not be fearful of loud burner noises
Expectant mothers or possibly pregnant women are not permitted to fly
All guests must stand unassisted for the entire flight and climb into and out of the gondola unassisted
Guests must be in good overall health and able-bodied; gondolas are not wheelchair accessible and cannot accommodate service dogs, oxygen tanks, crutches or canes
No animals, babies, infants, backpacks, purses, camera bags, or selfie sticks (except on private flights) allowed

blurb: Guests enjoy a 45-minute to 1-hour hot air balloon flight over Sonoma County wine country, including pre-flight refreshments and a post-flight champagne toast. Private and group flights are available, as well as combined balloon and e-bike tours. Flights depart at sunrise and include a commemorative flight certificate on request.
extraNote: Flights operate once per day around sunrise and are weather permitting; pilots will not fly if conditions are unsafe · If canceled due to inclement weather (rain, fog, high winds), guests will be rescheduled or refunded in full · Standard join-in flights require cancellation notice at least 72 hours prior; private flights require 30 days notice · No-shows are charged in full and will not be rebooked · Late arrivals are not waited for; payment is forfeited if missed · Hilton Garden Inn in Santa Rosa, CA, with shuttle to launch site if needed
